BiblicalUsage: Kabzeel is a town on Judah's southern border toward Edom. It is remembered because of one man: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who slew two lionlike men of Moab and a lion in a pit on a snowy day.
TheologicalSignificance: I take the town's fame as a reminder that God remembers small places by the faithful men who came out of them.
